newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns Aaa to TEPCO's 4 bln Ffr straights.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aaa to TEPCO's 4 bln Ffr straights.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had assigned an Aaa rating to Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc's (TEPCO) 6.5 percent four billion French franc straight bonds due September 27, 2006.
The rating is based on TEPCO's importance to the national economy and its very favourable industry operating environment, the rating agency said.

Moody's said that TEPCO has an effective monopoly to serve Japan's most important economic region, the Kanto region, which includes the Tokyo metropolitan area. The service territory of TEPCO has over 30 percent of Japan's population and over 35 percent of the national gross domestic product.
